name: art.funai/studio
title: FunAI Studio
description: Generate images, video, audio, 3D and text with hundreds of AI models, Tools and templates.

environmentVariables.name: FUNAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional developer API key from https://developers.funai.art/keys. Usage then bills the developer API balance. Leave it unset to sign in to FunAI in the browser instead.

environmentVariables.name: FUNAI_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional server URL. Defaults to https://mcp.funai.art.
